dialog.reason: Keep: owned Base UI Dialog adapter supplies shared portal, focus and layout APIs; preserve calendar, meal, medication and search consumers. See docs/ui-registry-coverage.md.

EditorDialog.reason: Keep: guarded Base UI composition preserves dirty/pending dismissal, nested discard confirmation and focus return for template editors. See docs/ui-registry-coverage.md.

button.reason: Keep: Base UI Button with application semantic variants, compact sizes and buttonVariants for router links; ButtonGroup is a visual group, not tabs. See docs/ui-registry-coverage.md.

alert.reason: Keep: static semantic-tone container; consumers explicitly choose alert/status roles for translated feedback.

spinner.reason: Keep: CSS loading indicator; consumers supply translated loading text and status semantics where appropriate.

card.reason: Keep: semantic layout slots preserve feature grids and compact headers/footers; no interaction primitive required.

input.reason: Keep: native Input/Textarea preserve browser date/time/number validation and existing onChange/form APIs.

badge.reason: Keep: static status labels with application semantic variants; no interaction primitive required.

list-group.reason: Keep: Base UI useRender supports actual button/link/list semantics and flush/active rows; it is not a listbox or keyboard-selection primitive.

field.reason: Keep: presentational Field/Label/Description/Error slots integrate existing TanStack Form; consumers own id, htmlFor and aria-describedby wiring.

select.reason: Keep: native select preserves option children, native mobile picker and event.target.value consumers; custom popup selection is not currently required.

checkbox.reason: Keep: native checkbox preserves checked/onChange, labels and submitted values for bulk selection and preferences.

close-button.reason: Keep: shared labelled Lucide close button preserves translated accessible names and dialog styling.

progress.reason: Keep: determinate percentage indicator with explicit progressbar values; consumer supplies accessible name.

table.reason: Keep: native table slots and horizontal overflow retain TanStack sorting/filtering/visibility and compact cells; no duplicate data-table state.

radio.reason: Keep: native same-name radio grouping preserves browser arrow-key and form behavior without a second state model.

switch.reason: Keep: native checkbox styled as an on/off control preserves checked/onChange and associated labels; not a multi-state selector.
